description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kohuwala, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District  - Cad. Map No. 520801 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for multiple parcels in Kohuwala and Kalubowila. It includes detailed schedules of land parcels with their extent, ownership details, and encumbrances, making it clearly a land-related matter falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
